people.name: Antioch
people.line: A city in Pisidia where Paul preached the gospel.

people.name: Iconium
people.line: A city in Asia Minor visited by Paul

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
translations.bsb: Then some Jews arrived from Antioch and Iconium and won over the crowds. They stoned Paul and dragged him outside the city, presuming he was dead.
translations.kjv: And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and, having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead.
translations.asv: But there came Jews thither from Antioch and Iconium: and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.
